scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @poker/server" "npm run dev -w @poker/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @poker/web && npm run build -w @poker/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/game-engine && tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
